Priya (CSM): Heads up — HelioForm's token usage dropped ~45% over the last 14 days and their new ML lead is running a competitive eval. They asked for a per-route cost breakdown, SLOs, and a 2-week private canary. Who can triage?
Sam (AE): I talked to their exec sponsor yesterday. Budget still there but they're picky about split license vs pure API. I'll loop in procurement. @Nora can you prep a short tech brief on latency/risks for a split private/hosted setup?
Nora (Solutions Eng): Yep. I need a sample workload (seq len dist, peak qps). We can propose KV cache + 8-bit quantization to cut token cost. Possible canary config: Dedicated pool + fallback to hosted variant for overflow. Can keep 95th p99 under ~200ms in most cases.
Priya (CSM): Uploading a scrubbed sample payload now: https://files.redwood.internal/helioform/sample-export-2026-03.json (shared with SRE perms). They specifically called out data residency + audit logs.
Raj (CS Ops): I can run a split-deployment cost sim. Need model family, quantization target, and expected qps/seq len. If timeline is tight I can stand up a dev cluster (helm) and run an A/B with synthetic load. ETA 48h.
Sam (AE): I'll confirm whether they're putting the pilot under a PO or a POC budget. They mentioned FastServe as the competitor.
Priya (CSM): HelioForm's asks summarized for the email: 1) side-by-side latency + cost delta for split license, 2) 2-week canary with KMS + audit logs enabled, 3) a 30m enablement walkthrough for their ML team.
Nora (Solutions Eng): For KMS/audit:
```
- Private: KMS/HSM supported, syslog + audit retention 90d
- Dedicated: customer network peering, token-level metrics in console
- Hosted API: structured usage export + token breakdown (not KMS)
```
Nora (Solutions Eng): Also, suggest sample canary config: continuous batching disabled for low latency flow; prefix caching enabled for chat flows; fallback policy -> hosted small-quant model. I'll draft a short diagram.
Priya (CSM): Can we slot the walkthrough next Thu 11am PT? I told them 1 week turnaround for the canary plan.
Sam (AE): I'll ping procurement and set up invite. @Raj will you handle the dev cluster and simulate their workload? :thumbsup:
Raj (CS Ops): Confirmed. Spinning up helm chart + sample workload now. Will post the dev endpoint + cost sim by EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: alert: usage-drop-detected HelioForm (rule=customer-usage-decline) ts=4333209876
Priya (CSM): Thanks team — I'll draft customer email with timeline and attach Nora's brief once ready.
Sam (AE): If the canary shows favorable cost/latency we should offer a short-term discount on dedicated capacity to beat FastServe.
Priya (CSM): Noted — will coordinate with finance if needed.
Raj (CS Ops): Putting results in #eng-sre once the dev run completes.
Nora (Solutions Eng): Draft brief will be in this thread by EOD.
Priya (CSM): Closing loop — plan: 48h cost sim from Raj, EOD brief from Nora, Sam to confirm procurement next steps. I'll send the customer summary after I have the cost sim.
